SONNA Mua bán acc Dragon Ball Legends uy tín. Acc được kiểm tra trước khi đăng, giao tự động sau thanh toán, hỗ trợ trong giờ làm việc. SONNA là bên trung gian mua bán tài khoản, không liên kết với nhà phát hành Dragon Ball Legends. Tên game và nhân vật thuộc về chủ sở hữu tương ứng.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
body{margin:0;background:#F4F5FA}
a{color:#5B1F7A;text-decoration:none}a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
button{font-family:inherit}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #FF8A1F;outline-offset:2px}
@keyframes kvmarq{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.kv-track{display:inline-flex;white-space:nowrap;animation:kvmarq 22s linear infinite}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.kv-track{animation:none}}
.card:hover{border-color:#5B1F7A}
@media (max-width:640px){
.cat-grid{display:grid !important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;gap:14px 6px !important;padding:16px 8px !important}
.cat-tile{min-width:0;padding:4px 2px !important;gap:6px !important}
.cat-tile > span:first-child{width:56px !important;height:56px !important;border-radius:12px !important}
.cat-tile > span:first-child svg{width:30px !important;height:30px !important}
.cat-tile > span:last-child{font-size:11.5px !important;line-height:1.25 !important;letter-spacing:0 !important}
}

.store-category-section{position:relative}
.store-category-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:78px;padding:12px 15px;border:1px solid #E3E1EC;border-left:5px solid #5B1F7A;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(38,21,68,.09);transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
.store-category-head:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--category-color) 24%,transparent)}
.store-category-icon{width:50px;height:50px;flex:0 0 50px;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #ffffff;border-radius:15px;background:#171C2B;box-shadow:0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--category-color) 25%,transparent);transition:transform .22s ease}
.store-category-head:hover .store-category-icon{transform:rotate(-5deg) scale(1.05)}
.store-category-icon img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.store-category-title{min-width:0;flex:1}
.store-category-title h2{margin:0;color:#211735;font-family:'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(19px,2.3vw,25px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.store-category-metrics{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:7px;flex:0 0 auto;flex-wrap:wrap}
.store-category-platform,.store-category-metric,.store-category-total{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-height:30px;padding:5px 9px;border:1px solid #E3E1EC;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:#5A5470;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}
.store-category-platform{font-weight:750}
.store-category-metric strong{color:#211735;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.store-category-total{background:#F4F5FA;border-color:#EAE7F0;font-weight:650}
.store-category-section .card{transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.store-category-section .card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 20px color-mix(in srgb,var(--category-color) 20%,transparent)}
.store-category-section.flame-category{position:relative;z-index:1;overflow:visible!important;border-color:#ff7417!important;box-shadow:0 0 12px 2px rgba(255,99,24,.68),0 0 26px 5px rgba(255,169,38,.42)}
.store-category-section.flame-category::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-5px;z-index:5;border:3px solid #ff7417;border-radius:inherit;background:transparent;box-shadow:0 0 8px 2px rgba(255,106,24,.95),inset 0 0 9px rgba(255,155,32,.7);pointer-events:none;animation:reroll-fire-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes reroll-fire-pulse{0%{border-color:#ff4b12;box-shadow:0 0 7px 2px rgba(255,72,18,.95),inset 0 0 8px rgba(255,94,18,.72)}50%{border-color:#ffd166;box-shadow:0 0 16px 4px rgba(255,184,37,1),inset 0 0 12px rgba(255,205,77,.86)}100%{border-color:#ff7417;box-shadow:0 0 10px 3px rgba(255,106,24,.98),inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,138,24,.82)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.store-category-section.flame-category::before,.store-category-section,.store-category-head,.store-category-icon,.store-category-section .card{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;transform:none!important}}
@media(max-width:760px){.store-category-head{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}.store-category-title{flex-basis:calc(100% - 68px)}.store-category-metrics{margin-left:60px;justify-content:flex-start}}
@media(max-width:560px){.store-category-head{min-height:70px;padding:10px 11px;gap:9px}.store-category-icon{width:44px;height:44px;flex-basis:44px;border-radius:13px}.store-category-metrics{margin-left:53px;gap:5px}.store-category-platform,.store-category-metric,.store-category-total{min-height:27px;padding:4px 7px;font-size:10px}.store-category-metric strong{font-size:11px}}
</style>
